protocol: For each of lot2, lot3, and a595: one warmup decode_all, then 8 timed decode_all calls. records_per_sec is total records divided by total timed seconds. Ten separate process starts.
rationale: Inside the ten runs the largest deviation from the median was 0.141. A later invocation of the same release binary, through scripts/bench_adapter.py, was about 0.203 above that median. min_relative_gain is 0.30 so it is above both observations. The runner also takes the median of five paired repeats. Do not lower the threshold after a candidate fails; remeasure on the evaluation host first.
